summary: Frontend-only testing of the 3 new Invoice History enhancements (search, payment status/unpaid total, export/import) plus regression on persistence and duplicate. 20/20 assertions passed on the public preview URL. All flows verified end-to-end using Playwright with data-testid selectors.

issues: Multi-currency amounts render inline with no separator (e.g. '171 360,00 DA171 360,00 €'). Visually readable via distinct spacing but a divider or comma would improve legibility. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: InvoiceHistory.jsx & InvoiceApp.jsx are well-scoped (<250 lines each), use useMemo appropriately, and correctly guard export button when history is empty.

importHistory does not validate individual entry shape beyond `x.invoice.number` existence — a malformed entry (e.g. missing items) could be merged and later crash computeTotals. Consider deeper validation.
exportHistory filename uses todayISO() — fine, but two exports on the same day overwrite in some browsers; adding a timestamp suffix would be safer.

toggleStatus and importHistory rely on entry.id uniqueness; imported entries keep their original id (from a foreign export). If two backups share an id, later toggleStatus would flip both. Consider re-generating id on import.
unpaidByCurrency computes computeTotals inside .forEach for every render pass — acceptable but could memoize per entry if history grows large.
history-status-<invoiceNumber> testid uses the invoice number which can contain characters that need escaping in CSS selectors; current numbers are safe but ids from imports could cause issues.
seed_data_creation: Two invoices saved in-app via UI (FAC-2026-001 Entreprise Horizon, FAC-2026-002 Studio Lumen) + one imported via file upload (FAC-2026-050 Imported Co).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new history features (search, payment status + unpaid-total, export/import) work correctly. Toast overlay from sonner intercepts pointer events; use JS-level clicks (element.click() via page.evaluate) rather than page.click to bypass without unmounting toasts (removing toast DOM manually crashes React reconciler). Multi-currency unpaid grouping verified by re-opening an entry, switching currency to EUR and re-saving (upsert preserves status). Duplicate correctly increments to next non-colliding number (FAC-2026-003 when 001/002/050 exist).
